actions.label: Scroll back one line
actions.caption: ctrl+e moves the window down twice first; ctrl+y scrolls it up one line. Recover the field just above the visible window.

actions.label: Scroll the structure down one line
actions.caption: ctrl+e scrolls the single-pane structure down one line. Keep scanning a long outline without a full-page jump.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
